plugins.name: customer-reply
plugins.description: Customer service scriptwriter built on one insight: most complaints escalate not because of the problem itself, but because the first reply was wrong. Generates copy-paste-ready replies for all four scenarios - pre-sales inquiries, after-sales support, complaints, and returns & refunds - each with a five-level emotion-soothing strategy matched to the customer's state (calm / anxious / unhappy / furious / disappointed). Every plan includes first reply, follow-up and escalation scripts; complaints get an extra contingency plan for further escalation. Golden rules enforced: feelings before facts, specific commitments (time, plan, owner) instead of vague promises, and banned phrases ('no idea', 'can't help', 'not my job', 'policy says no') auto-replaced with positive phrasing. Tone adapts by channel (casual for live chat, formal for email, warm for social media) and industry vocabulary (e-commerce, SaaS, F&B, education, finance) is woven in automatically. Batch generation supported for multi-scenario script libraries.
